koneksa-gitops.title: Koneksa GitOps deployment workflows
koneksa-gitops.summary: Built and improved GitOps CI/CD workflows using Argo CD and GitHub Actions for applications running on Kubernetes.
koneksa-gitops.problem: Deployment workflows needed to be more consistent, auditable, and less dependent on manual intervention.
contribution: Worked on Argo CD and GitHub Actions deployment workflows.
Added or improved validation and deployment safeguards.
Used Git as the desired-state source for deployment configuration.
Focused on reusable patterns rather than one-off deployment fixes.
interview_angles: tradeoffs between guardrails and team autonomy
guardrails: Do not claim sole ownership of the entire deployment platform.
Ask for more detail if a question requires an implementation fact not included here.

rapid7-eks-migration.problem: Existing CI/CD workloads needed a more scalable and resilient infrastructure pattern.
contribution: Helped migrate more than 20 CI/CD systems.

interview_angles: scaling one pattern across many workloads
guardrails: Do not invent the exact migration timeline.
